title: rudbeckia hirta var. sericea
intro:
Rudbeckia hirta var. sericea, commonly known as the Silky Black-eyed Susan, is a variety of flowering plant that belongs to the daisy family. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and alleviating anxiety. The therapeutic actions of Rudbeckia hirta var. sericea are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and triterpenoids. However, further research is needed to confirm the bioactive constituents and their effects on human health.
